title: MySQL Buffer Pool Hit Low - V4B ID Prod

model.rawSql: SELECT ROUND((1 - (SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads') / NULLIF((SELECT VARIABLE_VALUE FROM performance_schema.global_status WHERE VARIABLE_NAME = 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests'), 0)) * 100, 2) as hit_pct

annotations.description: Buffer pool hit rate below 95%. Excessive disk I/O, queries may be slow.
annotations.summary: MySQL buffer pool hit rate low on V4B ID Prod

title: MySQL Long Running Query - V4B ID Prod

model.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM information_schema.PROCESSLIST WHERE TIME > 60 AND COMMAND NOT IN ('Sleep', 'Binlog Dump GTID', 'Daemon') AND USER NOT IN ('cloudsqladmin', 'cloudsqlreplica')

annotations.summary: Long running query detected on V4B ID Prod
